titulo: NASA’s B777 Gets New Coat of Paint
cuerpo: NASA’s Boeing 777 shows off a new paint job in this Aug. 11, 2026, photo. The B777 was acquired to replace and extend the capabilities of the NASA DC-8, which was retired in 2024.
